annotations.title: Make a 3D video of a Hawaiʻi lot

description: A looping 3D video (MP4) of one Hawaiʻi lot by TMK, the lot swinging left and right with its lot line on the ground, drawn from USGS lidar. Returns a download link that works for a day. Free: 1 clip a month. More with ParcelSheet Pro ($22 a month).

address.description: Or a Hawaiʻi street address, e.g. 4-1345 Kuhio Hwy, Kapaa

tmk.description: Hawaiʻi Tax Map Key, 9 digits, dashes optional, e.g. 4-4-2-016-063
